editorial: Dark alleys of L.A. flicker beneath a relentless chase that feels more like a detective’s bad dream than a procedural. In The Little Things, your empathy and patience are pulled forward as Deputy Deacon’s haunting past intertwines catastrophically with Baxter’s evidence. Joaquin Phoenix delivers a bone deep, almost whispered performance that leaves a lasting impression on every frame. Fans of slow burn psychological thrillers will appreciate the meticulous pacing and grainy suspense, even if the final act occasionally drags. If you crave a tense, character driven mystery that trades flashy action for unsettling introspection, this is the one.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
